meta.description: Complete template definitions for the CV Builder. Each template defines its visual identity, layout, typography, color tokens, and per-element styling commands. These are consumed by the template renderer components.

sharedTokenSchema.description: Every template must define ALL of these tokens. The renderer injects them as CSS variables on the CV root element.

commandReference.description: All possible values for every command field across all templates.

layout.type.description: Determines the overall column structure of the CV.

layout.headerStyle.description: Controls how the header (name, contact) is displayed.

header.photoStyle.description: Position and shape of the profile photo.

header.contactLayout.description: How contact info items are arranged.

sections.dividerStyle.description: The style of the horizontal line below each section title.

sections.titleLayout.description: Positioning and rule behavior of section titles.

decorations.sidebarPatternType.description: Repeating CSS background pattern for the sidebar.

skills.defaultDisplayStyle.description: How skill items are rendered. Can be overridden per-resume by the user.

typography.nameTransform.description: CSS text-transform applied to the full name.

typography.nameFontStyle.description: Whether the name is shown in italic.

sidebar.sections.description: Which section IDs are rendered in the sidebar vs. the main column. Only relevant for sidebar layout templates.
